evidence.quote: One of the challenges that humanoid robot designers face is power management. Agility Robotics Inc. today said it is working with Nyobolt on a fast-recharge battery system for its Digit 5 system. The technology will allow the robot to work more than 20 hours in a day, the companies claimed.

robot designed to work in close proximity to people safely and at scale. It will include a new battery system that delivers 90 minutes of runtime and charges in just nine minutes. This 10:1 run-to-charge ratio is an improvement from Digit 4’s 2:1 ratio.
Agility said it expects early access to Digit 5 equipped with Nyobolt’s technology to begin in the first half of 2027. Availability will increase over the following six to nine months, it added.

title: Agility chooses Nyobolt for ultra-fast charging for Digit 5 humanoid
displayTitle: Agility 为 Digit 5 选用 Nyobolt 快充方案，早期交付预计 2027 年启动
summary: The Robot Report 报道 Agility Robotics 与 Nyobolt 合作开发 Digit 5 电池系统。公司称新系统可运行 90 分钟、充电 9 分钟，从而支持每日超过 20 小时的工作目标；搭载方案的 Digit 5 预计 2027 年上半年开始早期交付。
investorNote: 人形机器人经济性很大部分取决于可用工时；90 分钟续航与 9 分钟快充仍需真实场景验证。
narrative: Agility Robotics 选择 Nyobolt 为 Digit 5 开发快充电池。公司给出的目标是 **运行 90 分钟、充电 9 分钟**，希望让机器人在 24 小时内工作超过 20 小时；搭载该方案的 Digit 5 预计到 2027 年上半年才开始早期交付。对仓储和制造客户，续航数字要和充电排队、维护、任务切换一起算，才能变成真实可用工时。今天确认的是供应合作与产品计划，尚不是大规模现场运行数据。

eventRelation.reason: 新电池供应合作与前期 Digit 5 本体发布、Agility 管理层任职是不同动作。
